prose.against: The case against rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: free cash flow for the last financial year was negative: the business spent more than it generated. Other areas on this side: price behaviour, the quality of the business, what the price implies.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 10 points in favour and 7 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 53 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth.
